description: Na₃Mg(CO₃)₂Cl crystallizes in the cubic Fd̅3 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O and two equivalent Cl atoms. There are two shorter (2.36 Å) and two longer (2.42 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.85 Å. Mg is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Mg-O bond lengths are 2.06 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.29 Å. O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mg, and one C atom. Cl is bonded to six equivalent Na atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ClNa₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 60°.
